subject: Brief follow-up: commit to one of two short slots for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@marketlytics.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brief follow-up: commit to one of two short slots for technical deep dive

Alex — thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap and next steps below so we can get a technical deep dive on the calendar.

What I heard: you care most about inference latency at QPS, model size/quantization options, and on-prem data controls for a subset of transactions. Monica and I captured a short list of priorities (attached).

Suggested next step: 30-minute technical deep dive where our infra engineer walks through: runtime topology, quantization tradeoffs, and a short cost/latency projection for your sample workload. To avoid back-and-forth, can you please confirm one of these two tight windows? We’ll send a calendar invite as soon as you pick one and mark it as "firm" so your team can lock it.

Option A — Tue 23 Mar, 09:00–09:30 PT
Option B — Tue 23 Mar, 16:00–16:30 PT

Please reply with A or B and the names/titles of people who will attend from your side (so we bring the right engineers). If neither works, flag 2 contiguous 30-minute windows and we’ll do our best to hold one.

Attachments: discovery-notes-marketlytics-20270318.pdf (notes), SOW_template_marketlytics_v1.docx (initial template)

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez

Either of the two options should work for us in principle, but I need to confirm with Samantha (our platform lead). Can you hold both for a short time? If you can only hold one, lean toward Option B (late afternoon) — higher chance we can pull in our infra lead.

Tentative attendee list (pending confirmation):
- Alex Nguyen — Head of Product
- Samantha Lee — Platform Lead
- one engineering manager (TBD)

I’ll confirm by EOD tomorrow. If you need a firm answer sooner, we can do Option B and I’ll escalate internally.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — quick ping to tighten this down. We can hold BOTH slots for 24 hours but will need a firm pick by EOD tomorrow (Mon 22 Mar) so our infra engineer can block time. If we don’t hear back by then we’ll release Option A and keep Option B on hold for 48 hours.

If it helps: pick B and reply with a single word "B" + attendee names. That will trigger the calendar invite and I’ll drop a one-page slide (agenda + required prework) to keep the session focused.

We’ll have Rishi on to run the latency/cost projections and Monica will cover quantization/config recommendations.

Quick checklist for you when you confirm:
- Confirm slot (A or B)
- Confirm attendees (names + titles)
- Share one sample request profile (QPS/avg tokens) or a small anonymized sample trace (optional but very helpful)

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/DL-2026-0041
